21:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Monday Night Kickoff
The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

21:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Football
The Baltimore Ravens host the Los Angeles Chargers in NFL regular-season play at M&T Bank Stadium. Baltimore enters at 4-5 after four straight losses, but the Chargers have yet to win this season, arriving 0-8 after a 44-22 defeat to Houston.
